column1: # Pinned smoke games for `make smoke-launch` (#48): the community example, no game pinned (#190). Pin ONE ROM
# per system you own, the file name inside /data/roms/<system>/. A private checkout keeps its own table in
# personal/tests/smoke/smoke_games.tsv, which smoke_launch.py reads instead of this file.
# Columns (tab separated): system, rom, vm_rom, wait, motion.
#   system  every key of skills/collections/launch_expected.json (tests/smoke/test_smoke_launch.py checks both ways)
#   rom     file on the cabinet; "-" = no game pinned (the system has no ROMs there): SKIP, never PASS
#   vm_rom  file in the VM (LIMIT=coin-dojo-vm); "-" = none, SKIP. The VM never holds real games: only our own
#           generated NES test ROM (vm/guest/mknesrom.py), so only nes runs there.
#   wait    seconds until the alive check + first shot (default 10; a slow boot gets more)
#   motion  yes = the second shot (3 s later) must differ; no = the picture is static by design (a splash)
